description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ihalamakandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0115)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration particulars. It contains multiple declarations for different land parcels with detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and registration details, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
